summary: An unknown threat actor leveraged compromised IAM credentials from Qubole's AWS account to assume roles in customer environments. The actor performed broad discovery, harvested credentials, and exfiltrated S3 data opportunistically. A related bootable Linux ISO, sso_agent.iso, was also discovered, designed to establish C2 on victim machines.
